raw_segments.text: That man must not be immersed in business.
My son, always commit thy cause to me. I will dispose it a right in due time.
Wait for my arrangement of it, and then thou shalt find it for thy profit.
2. O Lord, right freely I commit all things to Thee, for my planning can profit but little.
O that I did not dwell so much on future events, but could offer myself altogether to Thy
pleasures without delay.
Three, my son, a man often strived vehemently after somewhat which he desiredeth, but when
he hath obtained it he beginneth to be of another mind, because his affections towards
it are not lasting, but rather rush on from one thing to another.
Therefore it is not really a small thing, when in small things we resist self.
For the true progress of man lieth in self-denial, and a man who denieth himself is free and safe.
But the old enemy, a poser of all good things, ceaseth not from temptation.
But day and night setteth his wicked snares, if happily he may be able to entrap the unwary.
Watch and pray, Seth the Lord, lest ye enter into temptation.
One.
1. Matthew Roman 26, 41
Enter goneral and oswald.
Gonaral, did my father strike my gentleman for chiding of his fool?
Oswald, I'm Adam.
Goneril, by day and night he wrongs me.
Every hour he flashes into one gross crime or other that sets us all at odds.
I'll not endure it.
His knights grow riotous and himself upbraids us on every trifle.
When he returns from hunting I will not speak with him, say I am sick.
If you come slack of former services you shall do well, the fault of it I'll answer.
Horns within.
Oswald, he's coming, madam, I hear him.
Goneril, put on what weary negligence you please, you and your fellows, I'd have it
come to question.
If he distaste it, let him to our sister, whose mind and mine, I know in that are one
not to be overruled.
I'd a old man that still would manage those authorities that he hath given away.
Now by my life, old fools are babes again, and must be us'd with cheques as flatteries
when they are seen abuzz'd.
Remember what I have said.
Oswald, very well, madam.
Goneril, and let his knights have colder looks among you, what grows of it no matter,
advise your fellows so, I would breed from hence occasions, and I shall that I may speak.
I'll write straight to my sister to hold my very course.
Prepare for dinner.
Ex-Unt.
